Hi Alex / Paula,

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn about BrightCare's ingestion pipelines and the low-latency requirements you mentioned for clinical summarization. Quick recap and proposed next step: 

Recap (very short)
- Source types: EHR exports (HL7/CSV), secure SFTP drops, and some in-app notes.
- Volume/SLAs: ~200k tokens/day during peak; 75ms target p95 for short prompts, 250ms acceptable for longer batched runs.
- Key concerns: PII handling, retention, and SSO for the admin console.

Next step
We recommend a 45-minute technical deep dive to:
- Align on model variant/quantization tradeoffs for throughput,
- Walk through network/topology options for Redwood Private vs Dedicated,
- Validate SSO/KMS integration approach with your security team.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Wed, May 26 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Thu, May 27 — 2:00–2:45 PM PT
- Fri, May 28 — 9:00–9:45 AM PT

Please confirm: 1) which slot works, 2) final attendee list we should expect, and 3) whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet (we can send calendar invite either way).

I'll loop Karthik and Jonas on the session — Karthik will cover infra/SSO, Jonas will lead the performance discussion.

Attachments: I'll attach a short one-page discovery recap and a sample agenda in the follow-up invite.
